reason: A condition-driven monitoring plugin that persists file, command, HTTP, process, port, and webhook watches, then wakes agent sessions and exposes watch state through browser panels and routes.

summaries.zh: 用于注册并持久化文件、命令、HTTP、进程、端口和 Webhook 条件监视器，在条件触发时唤醒智能体并通过界面展示监视状态。
summaries.en: Registers persistent file, command, HTTP, process, port, and webhook watches that wake agent sessions on matching changes and expose their status in browser views.

capabilities: Monitors files, read-only shell command output, HTTP responses, processes, TCP ports, and webhooks
Wakes or resumes dormant agent sessions when watched conditions fire
Sends optional fire events to a configured webhook URL
Provides browser routes and dashboard controls to inspect and cancel watches
